name: HubSpot
summary: CRM and marketing, sales, service and content software with Breeze, the vendor's AI: Breeze Customer Agent, which resolves common support inquiries across channels without a person, and Breeze Prospecting Agent, which researches accounts, finds contacts and drafts personalized outreach for a rep to approve. For agents, the vendor publishes a remote MCP server at mcp.hubspot.com with documented read and write access to CRM records, activities, content and conversations, authorized by OAuth with PKCE through an MCP auth app in the account; measured 401 with no credentials.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-15, no credentials: MCP initialize at mcp.hubspot.com answers 401 with a Bearer challenge naming its protected-resource metadata, whose scopes_supported is empty. Vendor: OAuth with PKCE through an MCP auth app; scopes follow the tools present and permissions granted at install.

jobs.summary: Breeze Prospecting Agent, the vendor's words on this page: it uses "CRM data and real-time signals to craft personalized outreach"; "Reps review the agent's research and drafted outreach, then approve before anything sends." Metered per lead; edition not established. Not measured.

Breeze Customer Agent, the vendor's words on this page: "resolves common support inquiries automatically across channels, 24 hours a day, resolving up to 70% of conversations without human intervention"; hands off "when human judgment is needed". Professional and up, $0.50 each. Not measured.
